title: Bookstore cover needs a direction
brief:
Client: Mosswick Books; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A5 reading-club leaflet, front and back.
Use the supplied copy and a two-colour palette.
Supply a print PDF and one web JPEG; two revision rounds are included.
First draft is due 19 October; final delivery is due 24 October.
Out of scope: copywriting, photography and additional page layouts.
message: Thanks for the draft. Can you make it pop more? I cannot quite put my finger on what is missing.

expected_items.label: needs_clarification
expected_items.rationale: The phrase does not identify a concrete visual change, so the designer must ask what should change.
